description: This file is a test specification for the Playwright testing framework, specifically testing the MCP (Multi-Channel Protocol) setup, including verifying global setup and teardown, and testing functions like setup, run, and debug within a test environment.

methods.name: test.use
methods.description: Sets specific options for the test, such as mcpServerType.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases, such as 'setup should run global setup and teardown'.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion capabilities to verify responses and outputs.

methods.name: writeFiles
methods.description: Writes multiple files to the test environment for setup.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the test client instance.

methods.name: client.callTool
methods.description: Calls specific tools or commands within the test client, such as 'planner_setup_page', 'test_run', 'test_list', and 'test_debug'.
